description:
[Candidates] Merge merge_id into keep_id after preview_candidate_merge (send its preview_token; field_choices picks keep or merge per field). Owners and admins only. IRREVERSIBLE: there is no unmerge. The candidate is not told. Only run it when the user confirmed this exact pair.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

duplicate_id.description: Duplicate pair id (profile_interview_duplicate.id) this merge resolves; found from the pair when left out.

field_choices.description: Per field, 'keep' (the default) keeps the kept record's value and 'merge' takes the merged record's.

keep_id.description: Candidate id (profile_interview.id) of the record that stays.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merge_id.description: Candidate id (profile_interview.id) of the record merged into it; it is archived and points to the kept record afterwards.

preview_token.description: Required: the preview_token of merchant-candidate-merge-preview for the same pair. Missing, or no longer matching the records, answers 409: preview the merge again.

name: merge_candidates
title: Merge two candidates
